qualification_snapshot_026.role: historical qualification source recorded by G15

current_development_head.role: 0.2.7 source snapshot used for WP13 golden execution; later evidence/docs commits remain distinct

artifact_classification.SOURCE: tracked implementation and configuration used to execute the solver
artifact_classification.CONTROLLED_PROOF: versioned evidence with declared source SHA, policy and digest
artifact_classification.GENERATED_VIEW: reader-facing documentation or report derived from controlled records
artifact_classification.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: immutable evidence retained for a prior release or source snapshot
artifact_classification.BUILD_ARTIFACT: wheel, sdist and local build output; never a source or proof record

text_digest_policy.hash_input: canonical UTF-8 bytes after newline normalization
text_digest_policy.binary_policy: hash original bytes without text normalization

historical_record_policy: The 0.2.6 G15 record is historical evidence. Its recorded qualification SHA is not the current development head and is not rewritten to reflect later publication state.
release_workflow_policy: Publication must run from a tag reference whose v-prefixed name matches the package version. Manual confirmation does not bypass this contract.
